description: This is a Java interface defining the contract for a Two-Factor Authentication Configuration Service in the Fineract project. It includes methods for retrieving and updating 2FA settings such as SMS and email configurations, token properties, and formatted messages.

classes.name: TwoFactorConfigurationService
classes.description: This interface specifies the methods to access and modify two-factor authentication configuration settings within the system.

methods.name: retrieveAll
methods.description: Retrieves all current two-factor configuration settings as a map.

methods.name: getSMSProviderId
methods.description: Returns the identifier for the SMS provider used.

methods.name: getSmsText
methods.description: Gets the template or text for SMS messages.

methods.name: getEmailSubject
methods.description: Retrieves the email subject template for 2FA emails.

methods.name: getEmailBody
methods.description: Retrieves the email body template for 2FA emails.

methods.name: getFormattedEmailSubjectFor
methods.description: Generates the formatted email subject for a specific user and OTP request.

methods.name: getFormattedEmailBodyFor
methods.description: Generates the formatted email body for a specific user and OTP request.

methods.name: getFormattedSmsTextFor
methods.description: Generates the formatted SMS text for a specific user and OTP request.

methods.name: getOTPTokenLength
methods.description: Returns the length of the OTP token.

methods.name: getOTPTokenLiveTime
methods.description: Returns the validity duration of the OTP token.

methods.name: getAccessTokenLiveTime
methods.description: Returns the lifespan of the access token.

methods.name: getAccessTokenExtendedLiveTime
methods.description: Returns the extended lifespan of the access token.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates the 2FA configuration settings based on the provided JSON command.
